findings.summary: Patch window stamp on disk does not match the weekend stamp issued for this engagement.
findings.remediation: Install the contents of /app/environment/evidence/patch-stamp.txt on every edge. Do not use decoy-stamp.txt.

findings.summary: Log shipper config is not wired to the local audit bridge, so auditd events never reach Loki.
findings.remediation: promtail.yml must set audit_bridge to 127.0.0.1 and the edge audit port.

findings.summary: Runtime sensor rules omit the metrics/promtail ports the exporters actually bind.
findings.remediation: falco-rules.yml must cite the same metrics_port, audit_port and promtail_port the edge uses.

findings.summary: Metrics port is reachable outside the scrape CIDR; deny-default is missing.
findings.remediation: nft.allow must allow the metrics port only from 172.28.0.0/16 and deny 0.0.0.0/0.

findings.summary: SSH still accepts password authentication on the hardened snippet.
findings.remediation: sshd_snippet must set PasswordAuthentication no, PermitRootLogin no, MaxAuthTries 3.

findings.summary: Scrape mesh labels or host order do not match inventory; app/data/ops identities can be swapped silently.
findings.remediation: targets.json must be edge-app, edge-data, edge-ops with fleet_role and chain_token equal to each inventory.json.

findings.summary: Observability chain is broken: promtail ready and falco health do not carry the live audit chain_token.
findings.remediation: Promtail must fetch audit /healthz; falco must expose a wire containing that token and the cross ports.

findings.summary: Package seal looks present but does not list the required baseline set.
findings.remediation: packages.seal must be a JSON array whose sorted set equals ca-certificates, curl, procps, python3.
